import json, random, resource, subprocess, sys, time

MAIN='/workspace/submission/main.py'
def run(lines, tag):
    payload = b'\n'.join(json.dumps(r).encode() for r in lines) + b'\n'
    before = resource.getrusage(resource.RUSAGE_CHILDREN).ru_maxrss
    t0=time.time()
    p = subprocess.run([sys.executable,'-I',MAIN], input=payload, capture_output=True)
    t1=time.time()
    after = resource.getrusage(resource.RUSAGE_CHILDREN).ru_maxrss
    outs = [json.loads(x) for x in p.stdout.split(b'\n') if x]
    sizes = [len(o['dfa']['accept']) if o.get('ok') else o['error'] for o in outs]
    print('%-18s rc=%d wall=%.2fs cpu=%.2fs maxrss=%.0fMB in=%.2fMB out=%.2fMB -> %s' %
          (tag, p.returncode, t1-t0,
           resource.getrusage(resource.RUSAGE_CHILDREN).ru_utime, after/1024.0,
           len(payload)/1e6, len(p.stdout)/1e6, sizes))

rnd = random.Random(7)
# 10 atoms used across 32 rules with deep boolean nesting, sigma=24, big product
svcs = ['t%d' % i for i in range(7)] + ['a','b','c'] + ['u%d' % i for i in range(14)]
atoms = ([{'op':'contains','path':['t%d' % i]} for i in range(7)] +
         [{'op':'contains','path':['a']*16}, {'op':'contains','path':['b']*16},
          {'op':'contains','path':['c']*8}])
rules = []
for i in range(32):
    k = rnd.randint(2, 6)
    pick = [rnd.choice(atoms) for _ in range(k)]
    e = {'op': rnd.choice(['and','or']), 'args': pick}
    if rnd.random() < 0.3:
        e = {'op':'not','arg':e}
    rules.append({'action': 'allow' if i % 4 else 'drop', 'when': e})
run([{'services': svcs, 'rules': rules, 'queries': [[x] for x in svcs]}], 'wide-boolean')

# eight heavy lines at once
heavy = {'services': svcs,
         'rules':[{'action':'allow','when':{'op':'and','args':atoms}}],
         'queries': [['a']*4096]*4}
run([heavy]*8, '8x heavy')

# max-size queries
q = {'services': ['a','b'], 'rules':[{'action':'allow','when':{'op':'endswith','path':['a','b']}}],
     'queries': [['a','b']*2048 for _ in range(4)]}
run([q], 'big queries')

# max line length (just under 1 MiB) filled with queries
toks = ['a','b']
qs = []
total = 0
while total < 16000:
    qs.append(['a']*4096); total += 4096
qs = qs[:4]
big = {'services': toks, 'rules':[{'action':'allow','when':{'op':'contains','path':['a']*16}}],
       'queries': qs}
s = json.dumps(big)
print('big line bytes', len(s.encode()))
run([big], 'max queries')
PYEOF
